title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to download Microsoft partner materials (Resource library)
summary: Microsoft retired the old Dynamics 365 Partner Portal and consolidated partner resources into the microsoftpartners.microsoft.com domain. Partners can access Business Central materials through the AI Business Solutions section and Resource library, where they can filter by product or search by title for sales and reporting purposes.
key_points: Partner portal consolidated from dynamicspartners.transform.microsoft.com to microsoftpartners.microsoft.com
Business Central resources found under Explore AI Business Solutions partner resources section
Resource library accessible with filtering by product and search capabilities
Materials useful for internal reporting and pre-sales activities

quotes.text: Microsoft recently consolidated its domains, retiring dynamicspartners.transform.microsoft.com and merging it into microsoftpartners.microsoft.com.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key change partners need to know about where to find resources going forward

quotes.text: These materials are highly valuable for both internal reporting and pre-sales activities.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the business use cases and value of accessing the consolidated partner resources
